category_title: Students with personal, social, or academic challenges who prefer work-based learning
scenario_title: General academic subjects taught via traditional cognitive-based education
minimal_context: The student is sitting at an isolated desk in a classroom, expected to complete a math worksheet from a textbook.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your desks, open your math books, and complete the equations on the worksheet.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have a hard time just sitting here and taking this in. Math is just irrelevant information for what I actually want to do.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: This is part of the general subjects curriculum. Please try to focus on the paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have strong negative associations with these general subjects. I want to do actual work-based activities with concrete materials, not just stare at a book.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish this math assignment today. Just do your best to get through it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and pushes the books and papers off the desk) I'm not doing this traditional stuff anymore! It's completely useless! Hey, who wants to play cards instead of doing this stupid math?

task.content: Learning general subjects such as linguistic disciplines and math

context.environment: Classroom setting practicing academic cognitive-based education
context.materials: Books, papers and pencils at isolated desks, welding equipment, pieces of metal, couches, games, playing cards
context.social_setting: 16-25 students, not all of them motivated for schooling, and some with severe social or personal problems

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When required to learn by means of traditional, cognitive-based teaching
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Can cause chaos for diverse reasons
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Consider general subjects such as linguistic disciplines and math as irrelevant information

behavior_patterns.internal_state: Strong negative associations towards the general subjects
